tasks.name: Daily Standup Summary
tasks.prompt: Read PROGRESS.md and DECISIONS.md. Summarize in Thai: (1) current project status in 2-3 sentences, (2) top 3 tasks to work on today based on the Next section, (3) any blockers. Be concise — this is a morning standup. Do not modify any files.

tasks.name: Weekly Monday Reset
tasks.prompt: Read PROGRESS.md. Suggest what items in the Done section could be moved to an archive or cleaned up to keep the file concise. Only suggest — do not move, archive, or modify any files. List suggestions as bullet points.
